correctness.rationale: Given same S, all guarded partial maps of domain size ≤2 matching unary colours and the parent-class profile form a back-and-forth system on both finite and infinite nonempty models; guards cannot involve three distinct variables in this signature. For each profile v, explicit GF formulas Z/O/T with legal binary E guards express 0,1,≥2 colour multiplicities, so different S are separated. Canonical K(S) has one class per profile and total ≤c3^c. The all-profile existence sentence forces at least c3^c elements, realized by K(S); disjunctions of all possible profiles give the rank-three collapse and exact 2^(3^c-1)-1 theory count. Finite independent code checks 1954 structures, 418 guarded-bisimulation instances, and c=1,2,4 deletion minimality; experiments are not the all-size proof.
